title: Runtime research progress uses inverse cost-transition ratio

reproduction.observed: The runtime computes before * current_count / previous_count and recognizes only fixed count plus two legacy exponential formula forms. Factorio defines research_progress as the current fractional progress in [0,1], so unit-equivalent work preservation requires before * previous_count / current_count. Linear and hybrid canonical formulas are not evaluated.

root_cause.summary: Runtime code reconstructs cost from a narrow string grammar and applies the new-to-old ratio. It lacks the versioned semantic descriptors produced by the canonical research-cost authority.

regression_propositions: fixed linear exponential and hybrid form a complete sixteen-row transition matrix
completed unit-equivalent work is preserved across every recognized model transition
current research exact level fractional progress queue and completed levels are preserved
configuration change save reload and a second reload are idempotent
continuous execution equals save reload execution
unknown or over-budget descriptors fail closed without guessing
default behavior remains equivalent to public 3.2.3 except for the named correction
Factorio 2.0 receives an explicit target disposition and independent proof

closure.proof_required: descriptor-based canonical evaluation, corrected progress conversion, all sixteen transition rows, configuration-change and reload equivalence, exact engine realization, and target disposition before candidate freeze
